dm_levers: Shadow cloud: ranged attacks against this PC roll at DISADVANTAGE; the PC hides at ADVANTAGE. DM adjudicates on the combat rolls.

dm_levers: Rooted on a Biological creature: d4 damage/round via combat(action="damage", target="<target>", amount=<d4>, damage_type="kinetic"), heal the Neobloom the same amount; target STR save to tear free.

dm_levers: Lighter-than-air gas pods: slow, predictable flight; can act as a parachute for one other character. DM adjudicates in the fiction.

daily_use.note: Daily golden fruit. Eaten as a food ration, heals d10 + CON bonus HP. Max fruit in existence = the Neobloom's Level; cannot eat own fruit.

dm_levers: Spend d4 CON to create that many Sapling Retainers (LVL 1, AV 12, ML +1, ATK d6); they serve until end of day then wither. CON spend is real ability loss - DM applies and runs the retainers.

daily_use.name: Blast Pods
daily_use.note: Daily explosive pod (d10 blast damage). Max pods in existence = the Neobloom's Level.

19.name: Grafting
19.effect: Graft Biological creature part to branches/trunk. Gain appropriate attack/bonus. For each day grafted part alive, lose 1 CON

dm_levers: Graft a Biological creature part onto branches/trunk for an appropriate attack/bonus; lose 1 CON per day the graft stays alive. DM adjudicates the gain and applies the daily CON loss.

20.name: Puppeteer Roots
20.effect: Burrow roots into Biological creature's nervous system. Target EGO save vs control. Damage split between both entities

dm_levers: Burrow roots into a Biological creature's nervous system: target EGO save vs control; damage is split between both entities. DM adjudicates the contest and the damage split.
